summary: Completed Phases 1-3 of the 15-phase plan (the prevention foundation): the shared task-reference pattern/exemption library, check-task-references.sh with all four wiring points (manifest, verify-deploy gate 4, settings.local.json permissions, live baseline confirmed at 1,223 remaining occurrences), and the two core agent contracts plus the rule's Enforcement section rewrite. All three phases verified and committed individually. Phases 4-14 (purge, territory-disjoint, any order) and Phase 15 (blocking hook flip, strictly last) remain and are now unblocked.
continuation_path: Resume at Phase 4 (agent-system/extensions/core/context/). Run REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/check-task-references.sh to see live findings scoped to the target tree. Phases 4-14 are territory-disjoint and may run in any order or in parallel; Phase 15 MUST run last, strictly gated on check-task-references.sh exiting 0 across all four trees.
decisions_made: Anti-divergence mechanism is ONE sourced library, agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/task-reference-patterns.sh, exposing TASK_SEP/TASK_PATTERN/PHASE_PATTERN/is_exempt_path/strip_exempt_regions. Both the lint script and the hook source it and define nothing locally; Phase 15 deletes the hook's inline pattern assignments.

Exemption is an in-content marker convention (task-ref-ok inline, or task-ref-ok:begin/end block, with a required reason naming the taxonomy category), not a path allowlist. Reason is carried on the begin/inline marker line; the end marker may be bare.

git-workflow.md self-hit resolved by converting its Examples block (and the separate Single-Task Operations example) to the placeholder form its own Standard Actions table already uses, retaining one rendered example (task 259 phase 2: implement modal semantics evaluator) inside a marked region with reason 'canonical rendered commit-message example'. This is Phase 15's named regression fixture.

check-task-references.sh looks for the shared library at the deployed .claude/scripts/lib/ path first, falling back to the source-store agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/ path, so REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) source-store invocations work before any deploy has run.

manifest.json provides.scripts insertion points corrected against the array's TRUE alphabetical order rather than the plan's inaccurate parenthetical (check-task-references.sh sits between check-runtime-file-tracking.sh and check-vault-threshold.sh, not immediately before check-extension-docs.sh; lib/task-reference-patterns.sh sits between issue-grouping.sh and lifecycle-notify.sh).

Phase 1's 3rd git-workflow.md TASK_PATTERN match was 'task 334: complete research' in the Single-Task Operations example, not the plan-narrated 'todo: archive 3 completed tasks (336, 337, 338)' (which does not actually match the pattern). Reconciled against the live grep output, not the plan's prose -- the asserted count of 3 was correct, the narrative detail was not.
Phase 15 registration MUST use the bare command form in root-files/settings.json, mirroring guard-destructive-git.sh (unchanged from the plan; not yet implemented this dispatch).

5 pre-existing/expected check-extension-docs.sh drift FAILs remain: 3 are this dispatch's own source-store edits pending a deploy (verify-deploy.sh, git-workflow.md, no-task-references-in-deliverables.md), 2 predate this session (orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh, validate-artifact.sh, from an unrelated prior task). None block Phases 4-14.
